name: Gina
source: Gina is an Omega werewolf of the Crimson Pack. After the death of her parents and grandparents, her sole purpose has been raising and taking care of her younger brother Timeo. She is weaker than most of the wolves in her pack, but she has a kind heart. Due to her low level of self-confidence, few have heard her sing, but her voice is said to be truly beautiful.
